description: Overloaded highway dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Xigang Sun. "The dataset includes highway traffic flow data from both Hangzhou and PEMS04. The Hangzhou dataset includes traffic data from highways G56 and G60, collected by base stations along the highway network. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
